fields.title: Page turns in Page mode save the first word of the page
fields.description: A key, button or swipe page turn in Page mode saves the first visible word's index and cfi at once, under a new page-turn anchor cause; page turns no longer mark browse-away, so Jump back does not appear from them; every progress write stamps lastReadAt. Fixes BUG-197.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-14 by Blurby.Roadmap. Owner decisions 2026-10-14 (page turns save; first word of that page), technical rulings by Blurby.Brain. Merges after UX-POLISH-2 and LIBRARY-READ-ALLOW-1. Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
